column1: # to the frame's own quoted figure — additive rather than multiplicative
# components can be reasoned about in either order and the arithmetic is one integer
# multiply and one floor. A component with all six at 0 is refused by name: a component

#   damage_percent        Added to the frame's damage.
#   range_percent         Added to the frame's range.
#   spread_percent        Added to the frame's spread. Negative is tighter.
#   interval_percent      Added to the frame's seconds_per_shot. Negative is faster.
#   ammunition_percent    Added to the frame's ammunition_per_shot. Negative is cheaper.
#   damage_taken_percent  Added to the damage the *player* takes. Negative is armour

#                         GLOSSARY.md says Gear is "weapons and equipment".
